explanation: The number of algae cells per liter is quadrupling each day. From day 1 to day 2, the number increased from $5.0 \times 10^6$ to $2.0 \times 10^7$, a factor of 4. At the end of day $d$, the number of cells is $5.0 \times 10^6 \times 4^{d-1}$. Setting this equal to $5.12 \times 10^9$: $5.0 \times 10^6 \times 4^{d-1} = 5.12 \times 10^9$. Dividing both sides by $5.0 \times 10^6$ gives $4^{d-1} = 1024$. Since $4^5 = 1024$, we have $d - 1 = 5$, so $d = 6$.
